ko.title: 모라토리움 표: 2026년 주지사 선거가 데이터 센터 국민투표로 변하고 있는 이유

segments.src: ## A New Kind of Campaign Issue
segments.tr: ## 새로운 종류의 선거 이슈

segments.src: Data centers used to be the kind of infrastructure story that stayed in trade publications and local zoning meetings.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터는 예전에는 업계 출판물과 지역 지구 회의에만 나타나던 인프라 이야기였다.

segments.src: Heading into the 2026 midterms, that has changed.
segments.tr: 2026년 중간선거를 맞이하면서 그것이 바뀌었다.

segments.src: In statehouse races from the upper Midwest to the Gulf Coast, candidates are discovering that a pledge to pause, slow, or tightly regulate new data center construction can be as galvanizing on the campaign trail as taxes or crime once were.
segments.tr: 중서부 북부에서 멕시코만 해안까지의 주의회 선거에서, 후보자들은 새로운 데이터 센터 건설을 중단하거나 지연시키거나 엄격히 규제하겠다는 공약이 과세나 범죄만큼 선거 운동 중에 지지를 모을 수 있다는 것을 발견하고 있다.

segments.src: The shift reflects a simple reality: the artificial intelligence boom has a physical footprint, and voters are starting to feel it in ways that show up on monthly bills rather than in abstract debates about technology policy.
segments.tr: 이러한 변화는 간단한 현실을 반영한다: 인공지능 붐은 물리적인 영향을 미치고 있으며, 유권자들은 기술 정책에 대한 추상적인 논의보다는 월간 청구서에 나타나는 방식으로 그것을 느끼기 시작했다.

segments.src: ## Power Bills Are the Trigger
segments.tr: ## 전기요금이 촉발제

segments.src: The core grievance driving this trend is economic, not ideological.
segments.tr: 이 추세를 주도하는 핵심 불만은 이념적이 아닌 경제적이다.

segments.src: Data centers, particularly the large campuses built to train and run AI models, consume enormous amounts of electricity — often as much as a mid-sized city.
segments.tr: 데이터 센터, 특히 AI 모델을 훈련하고 실행하기 위해 지어진 대규모 캠퍼스는 엄청난 양의 전기를 소비한다 — 종종 중형 도시만큼 많다.

segments.src: In several states, utilities have proposed or won approval for new transmission lines, gas plants, and rate structures tied directly to serving these facilities.
segments.tr: 여러 주에서 유틸리티는 이러한 시설 운영을 직접 지원하기 위한 새로운 송전선, 가스 발전소 및 요금 구조를 제안했거나 승인을 받았다.

segments.src: Ratepayer advocates and some state regulators have raised concerns that the cost of that new capacity is, in part, being spread across residential customers rather than falling solely on the companies building the data centers.
segments.tr: 요금 납부자 옹호자들과 일부 주 규제 당국은 새로운 용량 비용의 일부가 데이터 센터를 건설하는 회사에만 국한되지 않고 주택용 고객들에게 분산되고 있다는 우려를 제기했다.

segments.src: That dynamic has given candidates a tangible, kitchen-table argument: household electricity bills rising while nearby land is cleared for server farms that employ relatively few permanent workers once construction ends.
segments.tr: 그러한 동학은 후보자들에게 구체적인 주요 쟁점을 제공했다: 건설이 끝나면 상대적으로 적은 수의 정규직 근로자를 고용하는 서버 팜을 위해 근처 토지가 개간되는 동안 가구 전기요금이 올라간다.

segments.src: Water use has become a parallel flashpoint, particularly in warmer or drought-prone regions, where cooling systems for large facilities draw on municipal or groundwater supplies that communities also rely on for drinking water and agriculture.
segments.tr: 수자원 사용은 특히 온난하거나 가뭄이 많은 지역에서 병렬적 갈등 지점이 되었다. 여기서 대규모 시설의 냉각 시스템은 지역사회가 음용수와 농업에도 의존하는 시 또는 지하수 공급원을 이용한다.

segments.src: ## A Rare Point of Bipartisan Overlap
segments.tr: ## 양당의 드문 겹침

segments.src: What makes this cycle notable is that the skepticism doesn't sort neatly along party lines.
segments.tr: 이 선거 주기를 주목할 만한 것은 회의론이 정당 노선을 따라 깔끔하게 분류되지 않는다는 것이다.

segments.src: In traditionally conservative areas, opposition has often centered on local control, property rights, and protecting agricultural land and rural water tables from industrial-scale development.
segments.tr: 전통적으로 보수적인 지역에서 반대는 종종 지역 통제, 재산권, 그리고 농업용 토지와 농촌 지하수위를 산업 규모 개발로부터 보호하는 데 중심을 두었다.

segments.src: In more liberal areas, the emphasis tends to fall on environmental review, corporate accountability for infrastructure costs, and equitable rate-setting.
segments.tr: 더 진보적인 지역에서 강조는 환경 검토, 인프라 비용에 대한 기업 책임, 그리고 공평한 요금 책정에 중점을 둔다.

segments.src: The result, in states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Florida, is a political environment where gubernatorial hopefuls from both parties have found room to campaign on similar-sounding promises — tighter permitting, mandatory community benefit agreements, or outright moratoriums on new approvals pending further study — even if their underlying rationale and preferred policy fixes diverge once the specifics are debated.
segments.tr: 위스콘신, 오하이오, 플로리다와 같은 주에서는 양당의 주지사 후보자들이 유사하게 들리는 공약들 — 더 엄격한 허가, 의무적 지역사회 편익 협약, 또는 추가 연구 대기 중인 새로운 승인에 대한 전면 모라토리움 — 에 대해 선거 운동할 여지를 찾은 정치 환경이 만들어졌다. 구체적인 사항이 논의되면 기본 근거와 선호하는 정책 해결책이 다를 수 있지만.

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument
segments.tr: ## 산업계의 반박

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: 기술 회사와 유틸리티 그룹은 데이터 센터가 호스트 지역사회에 상당한 세금 수입, 건설 일자리 및 장기 투자를 가져온다고 주장하면서 반발했으며, 그들은 종종 비판가들이 요금 납부자에게 부담을 준다고 말하는 바로 그 전력망 업그레이드에 자금을 조달해야 한다고 지적했다.

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: 업계 대표들은 또한 많은 새로운 시설들이 재생 에너지를 직접 계약하거나 특히 비용을 주택 고객에게 전가하지 않기 위해 프리미엄을 지불하고 있다고 지적한다.

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: 이러한 여러 선거의 주 경제 개발 담당자들은 일괄 모라토리움이 AI 붐보다 먼저 존재하는 기본 전력망 용량 문제를 반드시 해결하지 않으면서 투자 — 그리고 그것과 함께 오는 일자리와 세금 기반 — 를 더 허용적인 주 또는 국가로 밀어붙일 위험이 있다고 경고했다.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## 11월 이전에 주목할 사항

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:
segments.tr: 수사학을 정책과 구분하려는 유권자들을 위해, 이러한 경주가 전개되면서 추적할 가치가 있는 몇 가지 질문이 있다:

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **누가 전력망 업그레이드 비용을 지불하는가?** 대규모 산업 고객과 주택 요금 납부자 사이의 비용 배분에 대한 구체적인 제안을 주시하라. 이것이 청구서 인상과 가장 직접적으로 연결된 메커니즘이기 때문이다.

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **"일시 중지"에 해당하는 것은 무엇인가?** 모라토리움 제안은 광범위하게 다양하다 — 일부는 새로운 허가 승인만을 대상으로 하고, 다른 것은 이미 건설 중인 프로젝트를 중단할 것이며, 이는 별도의 법률 및 계약 문제를 야기한다.

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **수자원 사용은 어떻게 측정되고 공개되는가?** 공냉식 및 수냉식 시스템을 사용하는 시설은 매우 다른 지역 영향을 미치며, 주 수준의 투명성 요구 사항이 크게 다르다.

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.
segments.tr: 투표함에 도달하는 대부분의 인프라 분쟁과 마찬가지로, 이행의 세부 사항은 선거 슬로건보다 더 중요할 가능성이 높다.

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.
segments.tr: "모라토리움 표"가 지속 가능한 통치 의제가 되든 2026 선거 주기의 수사적 고점이 되든 간에, 이들 후보자가 사무실에 들어온 후 인기 있는 불만을 작동 가능한 규제로 어떻게 번역하는지에 크게 달려 있을 것이다.

segments.src: *This article summarizes publicly reported trends in state-level campaigns and is intended for general informational purposes.
segments.tr: *이 기사는 공개적으로 보고된 주 수준 선거운동의 추세를 요약하며 일반적인 정보 제공 목적으로 의도되었다.

segments.src: Readers should consult local election coverage and candidate platforms for specifics in their state.*
segments.tr: 독자들은 그들의 주의 구체적인 사항에 대해 지역 선거 보도 및 후보자 플랫폼을 참조해야 한다.*

zh.title: 暂停令议题：2026年州长竞选为何变成了数据中心的全民公投

segments.src: ## A New Kind of Campaign Issue
segments.tr: ## 一种新型的竞选议题

segments.src: Data centers used to be the kind of infrastructure story that stayed in trade publications and local zoning meetings.
segments.tr: 数据中心曾经是只出现在行业出版物和本地规划会议中的基础设施话题。

segments.src: Heading into the 2026 midterms, that has changed.
segments.tr: 进入2026年中期选举，情况已经改变。

segments.src: In statehouse races from the upper Midwest to the Gulf Coast, candidates are discovering that a pledge to pause, slow, or tightly regulate new data center construction can be as galvanizing on the campaign trail as taxes or crime once were.
segments.tr: 从上中西部到海湾沿岸的州议会竞选中，候选人发现承诺暂停、放缓或严格监管新数据中心建设，在竞选中的号召力与曾经的税收或犯罪议题一样强大。

segments.src: The shift reflects a simple reality: the artificial intelligence boom has a physical footprint, and voters are starting to feel it in ways that show up on monthly bills rather than in abstract debates about technology policy.
segments.tr: 这一转变反映了一个简单的现实：人工智能的繁荣带来了物理足迹，选民开始以月账单的形式直观感受到它，而不是在关于科技政策的抽象辩论中。

segments.src: ## Power Bills Are the Trigger
segments.tr: ## 电费账单是触发因素

segments.src: The core grievance driving this trend is economic, not ideological.
segments.tr: 推动这一趋势的核心不满是经济性的，而非意识形态上的。

segments.src: Data centers, particularly the large campuses built to train and run AI models, consume enormous amounts of electricity — often as much as a mid-sized city.
segments.tr: 数据中心，尤其是为培训和运行人工智能模型而建造的大型园区，消耗大量电力——通常相当于一个中等城市。

segments.src: In several states, utilities have proposed or won approval for new transmission lines, gas plants, and rate structures tied directly to serving these facilities.
segments.tr: 在几个州，公用事业公司已提议或获批新的输电线路、燃气厂和与服务这些设施直接相关的费率结构。

segments.src: Ratepayer advocates and some state regulators have raised concerns that the cost of that new capacity is, in part, being spread across residential customers rather than falling solely on the companies building the data centers.
segments.tr: 消费者权益倡导者和一些州监管机构表示担忧，新增容量的成本部分被摊入住宅用户账单，而不是全部由建设数据中心的公司承担。

segments.src: That dynamic has given candidates a tangible, kitchen-table argument: household electricity bills rising while nearby land is cleared for server farms that employ relatively few permanent workers once construction ends.
segments.tr: 这一动态给了候选人一个实实在在的论点：家庭电费上升，同时附近土地被开发成服务器农场，而这些农场在建设完成后只雇用相对较少的永久工人。

segments.src: Water use has become a parallel flashpoint, particularly in warmer or drought-prone regions, where cooling systems for large facilities draw on municipal or groundwater supplies that communities also rely on for drinking water and agriculture.
segments.tr: 用水已成为另一个引爆点，尤其在较温暖或干旱易发的地区，大型设施的冷却系统从社区用于饮水和农业的市政水或地下水供应中抽取。

segments.src: ## A Rare Point of Bipartisan Overlap
segments.tr: ## 罕见的两党共识点

segments.src: What makes this cycle notable is that the skepticism doesn't sort neatly along party lines.
segments.tr: 这个周期值得注意的地方在于，这种怀疑并不完全沿着政党界线划分。

segments.src: In traditionally conservative areas, opposition has often centered on local control, property rights, and protecting agricultural land and rural water tables from industrial-scale development.
segments.tr: 在传统保守地区，反对通常围绕本地控制、产权以及保护农业用地和农村地下水免受工业规模开发而展开。

segments.src: In more liberal areas, the emphasis tends to fall on environmental review, corporate accountability for infrastructure costs, and equitable rate-setting.
segments.tr: 在更加自由的地区，重点往往落在环保审查、企业对基础设施成本的问责，以及费率设定的公平性上。

segments.src: The result, in states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Florida, is a political environment where gubernatorial hopefuls from both parties have found room to campaign on similar-sounding promises — tighter permitting, mandatory community benefit agreements, or outright moratoriums on new approvals pending further study — even if their underlying rationale and preferred policy fixes diverge once the specifics are debated.
segments.tr: 结果是，在威斯康星州、俄亥俄州和佛罗里达州等州，形成了这样的政治环境：来自两党的州长竞争者都找到了宣传听起来相似的承诺的空间——更严格的许可审批、强制性社区利益协议，或待进一步研究期间对新批准的完全禁令——尽管他们的基本理由和偏好的政策方案在具体细节上可能存在分歧。

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument
segments.tr: ## 行业的反驳论点

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: 科技公司和公用事业集团进行了反驳，主张数据中心为东道社区带来可观的税收收入、建筑就业和长期投资，而且他们经常被要求资助批评者所说对消费者有负担的电网升级。

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: 行业代表也指出，许多新设施直接签约使用可再生能源或支付溢价，特别是为了避免将成本转移到住宅用户身上。

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: 几个竞选中的州经济发展官员警告称，全面禁令的风险是将投资——以及随之而来的工作和税基——推向更宽松的州或国家，同时不一定能解决先于人工智能繁荣出现的电网容量基本问题。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## 11月前需要关注的事项

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:
segments.tr: 对于试图区分竞选宣传与实际政策的选民来说，随着这些竞选的发展，以下几个问题值得跟踪：

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **谁承担电网升级费用？** 留意大型工业用户和住宅用户之间成本分配的具体提议，因为这是与账单增加最直接相关的机制。

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **什么算作"暂停"？** 暂停令提议差异很大——有些仅针对新许可批准，其他则会暂停已在建设中的项目，这会引发单独的法律和合同问题。

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **如何测量和披露用水情况？** 采用空冷系统和水冷系统的设施对本地的影响截然不同，各州的透明度要求也差异很大。

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.
segments.tr: 与大多数涉及投票箱的基础设施争议一样，实施细节可能比竞选口号更重要。

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.
segments.tr: "暂停令议题"是否会成为一项持久的执政议程或2026年周期中的修辞高点，将很大程度上取决于这些候选人上任后如何将普遍的不满转化为可行的监管。

segments.tr: *本文总结了州级竞选中公开报道的趋势，仅供一般信息参考。

hi.title: मोरेटोरियम टिकट: 2026 गवर्नर की दौड़ डेटा सेंटर्स पर जनमत संग्रह में क्यों बदल रही है

segments.src: ## A New Kind of Campaign Issue
segments.tr: ## एक नई प्रकार का अभियान मुद्दा

segments.src: Data centers used to be the kind of infrastructure story that stayed in trade publications and local zoning meetings.
segments.tr: डेटा सेंटर्स कभी बुनियादी ढांचे की कहानी का एक प्रकार थे जो व्यापार प्रकाशनों और स्थानीय ज़ोनिंग बैठकों में ही रहते थे।

segments.src: Heading into the 2026 midterms, that has changed.
segments.tr: 2026 के मध्यकालीन चुनावों की ओर बढ़ते हुए, यह बदल गया है।

segments.src: In statehouse races from the upper Midwest to the Gulf Coast, candidates are discovering that a pledge to pause, slow, or tightly regulate new data center construction can be as galvanizing on the campaign trail as taxes or crime once were.
segments.tr: अपर मिडवेस्ट से लेकर गल्फ कोस्ट तक की स्टेटहाउस दौड़ों में, उम्मीदवार यह खोज रहे हैं कि नए डेटा सेंटर निर्माण को रोकने, धीमा करने, या कसकर विनियमित करने की प्रतिश्रुति अभियान पथ पर कर या अपराध जितनी ही प्रेरक हो सकती है।

segments.src: The shift reflects a simple reality: the artificial intelligence boom has a physical footprint, and voters are starting to feel it in ways that show up on monthly bills rather than in abstract debates about technology policy.
segments.tr: यह बदलाव एक सरल वास्तविकता को दर्शाता है: कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता बूम का एक भौतिक पदचिह्न है, और मतदाता इसे ऐसे तरीकों से महसूस करने लगे हैं जो मासिक बिलों पर दिखते हैं न कि तकनीकी नीति के बारे में अमूर्त बहसों में।

segments.src: ## Power Bills Are the Trigger
segments.tr: ## बिजली के बिल ट्रिगर हैं

segments.src: The core grievance driving this trend is economic, not ideological.
segments.tr: इस प्रवृत्ति को चलाने वाली मूल शिकायत आर्थिक है, विचारधारात्मक नहीं।

segments.src: Data centers, particularly the large campuses built to train and run AI models, consume enormous amounts of electricity — often as much as a mid-sized city.
segments.tr: डेटा सेंटर्स, विशेष रूप से कृत्रिम बुद्धिमत्ता मॉडल को प्रशिक्षित करने और चलाने के लिए निर्मित बड़े परिसर, बिजली की विशाल मात्रा का उपभोग करते हैं — अक्सर एक मध्यम आकार के शहर जितना।

segments.src: In several states, utilities have proposed or won approval for new transmission lines, gas plants, and rate structures tied directly to serving these facilities.
segments.tr: कई राज्यों में, उपयोगिता कंपनियों ने नई ट्रांसमिशन लाइनों, गैस संयंत्रों, और दर संरचनाओं के लिए प्रस्ताव दिया है या अनुमोदन प्राप्त किया है जो सीधे इन सुविधाओं को सेवा प्रदान करने से जुड़े हैं।

segments.src: Ratepayer advocates and some state regulators have raised concerns that the cost of that new capacity is, in part, being spread across residential customers rather than falling solely on the companies building the data centers.
segments.tr: दर भुगतानकर्ता वकील और कुछ राज्य नियामकों ने चिंता व्यक्त की है कि उस नई क्षमता की लागत, आंशिक रूप से, आवासीय ग्राहकों में फैलाई जा रही है बजाय डेटा सेंटर बनाने वाली कंपनियों पर पूरी तरह पड़ने के।

segments.src: That dynamic has given candidates a tangible, kitchen-table argument: household electricity bills rising while nearby land is cleared for server farms that employ relatively few permanent workers once construction ends.
segments.tr: उस गतिविधि ने उम्मीदवारों को एक मूर्त, रसोई-टेबल तर्क दिया है: घरेलू बिजली के बिल बढ़ रहे हैं जबकि पास की भूमि सर्वर फार्मों के लिए साफ की जा रही है जो निर्माण समाप्त होने के बाद अपेक्षाकृत कुछ स्थायी कर्मचारियों को नियोजित करते हैं।

segments.src: Water use has become a parallel flashpoint, particularly in warmer or drought-prone regions, where cooling systems for large facilities draw on municipal or groundwater supplies that communities also rely on for drinking water and agriculture.
segments.tr: जल उपयोग एक समानांतर संकट बन गया है, विशेष रूप से गर्म या सूखे के प्रवण क्षेत्रों में, जहां बड़ी सुविधाओं के लिए शीतलन प्रणालियां नगरपालिका या भूजल आपूर्ति पर निर्भर हैं जिन पर समुदाय पीने के पानी और कृषि के लिए भी निर्भर हैं।

segments.src: ## A Rare Point of Bipartisan Overlap
segments.tr: ## द्विपक्षीय ओवरलैप का एक दुर्लभ बिंदु

segments.src: What makes this cycle notable is that the skepticism doesn't sort neatly along party lines.
segments.tr: इस चक्र को उल्लेखनीय बनाता है कि संदेह पार्टी लाइनों के साथ साफ-सुथरे तरीके से विभाजित नहीं होता।

segments.src: In traditionally conservative areas, opposition has often centered on local control, property rights, and protecting agricultural land and rural water tables from industrial-scale development.
segments.tr: परंपरागत रूप से रूढ़िवादी क्षेत्रों में, विरोध अक्सर स्थानीय नियंत्रण, संपत्ति अधिकार, और कृषि भूमि और ग्रामीण जल स्तर को औद्योगिक-पैमाने के विकास से सुरक्षित रखने पर केंद्रित रहा है।

segments.src: In more liberal areas, the emphasis tends to fall on environmental review, corporate accountability for infrastructure costs, and equitable rate-setting.
segments.tr: अधिक उदार क्षेत्रों में, जोर पर्यावरणीय समीक्षा, बुनियादी ढांचे की लागतों के लिए कॉर्पोरेट जवाबदेही, और न्यायसंगत दर निर्धारण पर पड़ता है।

segments.src: The result, in states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Florida, is a political environment where gubernatorial hopefuls from both parties have found room to campaign on similar-sounding promises — tighter permitting, mandatory community benefit agreements, or outright moratoriums on new approvals pending further study — even if their underlying rationale and preferred policy fixes diverge once the specifics are debated.
segments.tr: परिणाम, विस्कॉन्सिन, ओहियो, और फ्लोरिडा जैसे राज्यों में, एक राजनीतिक माहौल है जहां दोनों पार्टियों के राज्यपाल उम्मीदवारों को समान-ध्वनि वाली प्रतिश्रुतियों पर अभियान चलाने का अवसर मिला है — कसकर परमिटिंग, अनिवार्य सामुदायिक लाभ समझौते, या आगे के अध्ययन तक नई मंजूरी पर पूर्ण मोरेटोरियम — भले ही उनके अंतर्निहित तर्क और पसंदीदा नीति समाधान विस्तार से बहस करने के बाद भिन्न हो जाएं।

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument
segments.tr: ## उद्योग का प्रतिवाद

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: प्रौद्योगिकी कंपनियों और उपयोगिता समूहों ने विरोध किया है, यह तर्क देते हुए कि डेटा सेंटर मेजबान समुदायों को महत्वपूर्ण कर राजस्व, निर्माण नौकरियां, और दीर्घकालिक निवेश लाते हैं, और कि उन्हें अक्सर उन्हीं ग्रिड अपग्रेड को वित्तपोषित करने की आवश्यकता होती है जो आलोचकों का कहना है कि दर भुगतानकर्ताओं को बोझ डालते हैं।

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: उद्योग प्रतिनिधि यह भी नोट करते हैं कि कई नई सुविधाएं सीधे नवीकरणीय शक्ति के लिए अनुबंध कर रही हैं या विशेष रूप से लागतों को आवासीय ग्राहकों में स्थानांतरित करने से बचने के लिए प्रीमियम का भुगतान कर रही हैं।

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: इन कई दौड़ों में राज्य आर्थिक विकास अधिकारियों ने चेतावनी दी है कि एक व्यापक मोरेटोरियम निवेश — और उससे आने वाली नौकरियां और कर आधार — को अधिक अनुमानी राज्यों या देशों में धकेलने का जोखिम उठाता है, बिना आवश्यक रूप से अंतर्निहित ग्रिड क्षमता के सवालों को हल किए जो AI बूम से पहले की हैं।

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## नवंबर से पहले क्या देखना है

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:
segments.tr: जो मतदाता बयानबाजी को नीति से अलग करने की कोशिश कर रहे हैं, उनके लिए कुछ सवाल इन दौड़ों के विकास के साथ ट्रैक करने लायक हैं:

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **ग्रिड अपग्रेड के लिए कौन भुगतान करता है?** बड़े औद्योगिक ग्राहकों और आवासीय दर भुगतानकर्ताओं के बीच लागत आवंटन पर विशिष्ट प्रस्तावों पर नजर रखें, क्योंकि यह वह तंत्र है जो बिल वृद्धि से सबसे सीधे जुड़ा है।

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **"रुकावट" के रूप में क्या गिना जाता है?** मोरेटोरियम प्रस्ताव व्यापक रूप से भिन्न होते हैं — कुछ केवल नई परमिट मंजूरी को लक्ष्य करते हैं, अन्य पहले से चल रही परियोजनाओं को रोकेंगे, जो अलग कानूनी और संविदात्मक सवाल उठाते हैं।

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **जल उपयोग को कैसे मापा और प्रकट किया जाता है?** वायु-शीतलन बनाम जल-शीतलन प्रणालियों का उपयोग करने वाली सुविधाओं के बहुत अलग स्थानीय प्रभाव होते हैं, और राज्य-स्तर की पारदर्शिता आवश्यकताएं महत्वपूर्ण रूप से भिन्न होती हैं।

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.
segments.tr: जैसा कि अधिकांश बुनियादी ढांचे की लड़ाई के साथ होता है जो मतदान पेटी तक पहुंचती है, कार्यान्वयन के विवरण अभियान नारों की तुलना में अधिक महत्वपूर्ण होने की संभावना है।

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.
segments.tr: चाहे "मोरेटोरियम टिकट" एक टिकाऊ शासन एजेंडा बन जाए या 2026 चक्र का एक बयानबाजी शीर्ष बिंदु, इस पर काफी हद तक इस बात पर निर्भर करेगा कि ये उम्मीदवार कार्यालय में होने के बाद एक लोकप्रिय शिकायत को व्यावहारिक विनियमन में कैसे अनुवादित करते हैं।

segments.tr: Las empresas tecnológicas y los grupos de servicios públicos han respondido, argumentando que los centros de datos traen ingresos fiscales significativos, empleos de construcción e inversión a largo plazo a las comunidades anfitrionas, y que con frecuencia se les requiere financiar las mismas mejoras de la red que los críticos dicen que cargan a los clientes.

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: Los representantes de la industria también señalan que muchas instalaciones nuevas están contratando directamente energía renovable o pagando primas específicamente para evitar trasladar costos a los clientes residenciales.

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: Los funcionarios de desarrollo económico estatal en varias de estas carreras han advertido que un moratorio general corre el riesgo de empujar la inversión —y los empleos y la base impositiva que conlleva— a estados o países más permisivos, sin necesariamente resolver las preguntas subyacentes de capacidad de la red que preceden al auge de la IA.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## Qué Observar Antes de Noviembre

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:
segments.tr: Para los votantes que intentan distinguir la retórica de la política, hay algunas preguntas que vale la pena rastrear a medida que estas carreras se desarrollan:

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **¿Quién paga por las mejoras de la red?** Observe propuestas específicas sobre asignación de costos entre grandes clientes industriales y clientes residenciales, ya que este es el mecanismo más directamente vinculado a los aumentos de facturas.

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **¿Qué se considera una "pausa"?** Las propuestas de moratorio varían ampliamente: algunas se dirigen solo a nuevas aprobaciones de permisos, otras detendrían proyectos ya en construcción, lo que plantea preguntas legales y contractuales separadas.

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **¿Cómo se mide y divulga el uso del agua?** Las instalaciones que utilizan sistemas de enfriamiento por aire versus enfriamiento por agua tienen impactos locales muy diferentes, y los requisitos de transparencia a nivel estatal difieren significativamente.

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.
segments.tr: Como ocurre con la mayoría de las luchas de infraestructura que llegan a las urnas, los detalles de la implementación probablemente importarán más que los lemas de la campaña.

segments.src: ## Power Bills Are the Trigger

segments.src: Data centers, particularly the large campuses built to train and run AI models, consume enormous amounts of electricity — often as much as a mid-sized city.

segments.tr: ## نقطة تقاطع نادرة بين الحزبين

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## Ce qu'il Faut Observer Avant Novembre

pt.title: A Pauta do Moratório: Por Que as Eleições de Governador de 2026 Estão se Tornando Referendos sobre Data Centers

segments.src: ## A New Kind of Campaign Issue
segments.tr: ## Uma Nova Questão de Campanha

segments.src: Data centers used to be the kind of infrastructure story that stayed in trade publications and local zoning meetings.
segments.tr: Data centers costumavam ser o tipo de notícia de infraestrutura que permanecia em publicações especializadas e reuniões de zoneamento local.

segments.src: Heading into the 2026 midterms, that has changed.
segments.tr: Entrando nas eleições intermediárias de 2026, isso mudou.

segments.src: In statehouse races from the upper Midwest to the Gulf Coast, candidates are discovering that a pledge to pause, slow, or tightly regulate new data center construction can be as galvanizing on the campaign trail as taxes or crime once were.
segments.tr: Em eleições estaduais do Meio-Oeste superior à Costa do Golfo, candidatos estão descobrindo que um compromisso de pausar, desacelerar ou regular firmemente a construção de novos data centers pode ser tão mobilizador na campanha quanto impostos ou crime já foram.

segments.src: The shift reflects a simple reality: the artificial intelligence boom has a physical footprint, and voters are starting to feel it in ways that show up on monthly bills rather than in abstract debates about technology policy.
segments.tr: A mudança reflete uma realidade simples: o boom de inteligência artificial tem uma pegada física, e os eleitores estão começando a sentir isso de maneiras que aparecem nas contas mensais em vez de em debates abstratos sobre política tecnológica.

segments.src: ## Power Bills Are the Trigger
segments.tr: ## Contas de Energia são o Gatilho

segments.src: The core grievance driving this trend is economic, not ideological.
segments.tr: A reclamação central impulsionando essa tendência é econômica, não ideológica.

segments.src: Data centers, particularly the large campuses built to train and run AI models, consume enormous amounts of electricity — often as much as a mid-sized city.
segments.tr: Data centers, particularmente os grandes campuses construídos para treinar e executar modelos de IA, consomem enormes quantidades de eletricidade — frequentemente tanta quanto uma cidade de médio porte.

segments.src: In several states, utilities have proposed or won approval for new transmission lines, gas plants, and rate structures tied directly to serving these facilities.
segments.tr: Em vários estados, as concessionárias propuseram ou obtiveram aprovação para novas linhas de transmissão, usinas de gás e estruturas tarifárias vinculadas diretamente ao atendimento dessas instalações.

segments.src: Ratepayer advocates and some state regulators have raised concerns that the cost of that new capacity is, in part, being spread across residential customers rather than falling solely on the companies building the data centers.
segments.tr: Defensores dos consumidores e alguns reguladores estaduais levantaram preocupações de que o custo dessa nova capacidade está, em parte, sendo distribuído entre clientes residenciais em vez de recair apenas nas empresas que constroem os data centers.

segments.src: That dynamic has given candidates a tangible, kitchen-table argument: household electricity bills rising while nearby land is cleared for server farms that employ relatively few permanent workers once construction ends.
segments.tr: Essa dinâmica deu aos candidatos um argumento tangível e de mesa de cozinha: contas de eletricidade doméstica subindo enquanto terrenos próximos são limpos para fazendas de servidores que empregam relativamente poucos trabalhadores permanentes após o término da construção.

segments.src: Water use has become a parallel flashpoint, particularly in warmer or drought-prone regions, where cooling systems for large facilities draw on municipal or groundwater supplies that communities also rely on for drinking water and agriculture.
segments.tr: O uso de água se tornou um ponto de ignição paralelo, particularmente em regiões mais quentes ou propensas a secas, onde sistemas de resfriamento para grandes instalações dependem de suprimentos municipais ou de água subterrânea que as comunidades também dependem para água potável e agricultura.

segments.src: ## A Rare Point of Bipartisan Overlap
segments.tr: ## Um Ponto Raro de Sobreposição Bipartidária

segments.src: What makes this cycle notable is that the skepticism doesn't sort neatly along party lines.
segments.tr: O que torna este ciclo notável é que o ceticismo não se divide claramente ao longo das linhas partidárias.

segments.src: In traditionally conservative areas, opposition has often centered on local control, property rights, and protecting agricultural land and rural water tables from industrial-scale development.
segments.tr: Em áreas tradicionalmente conservadoras, a oposição frequentemente se centrou no controle local, direitos de propriedade e proteção de terras agrícolas e lençóis freáticos rurais do desenvolvimento em escala industrial.

segments.src: In more liberal areas, the emphasis tends to fall on environmental review, corporate accountability for infrastructure costs, and equitable rate-setting.
segments.tr: Em áreas mais liberais, a ênfase tende a cair na revisão ambiental, responsabilidade corporativa pelos custos de infraestrutura e estabelecimento equitativo de tarifas.

segments.src: The result, in states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Florida, is a political environment where gubernatorial hopefuls from both parties have found room to campaign on similar-sounding promises — tighter permitting, mandatory community benefit agreements, or outright moratoriums on new approvals pending further study — even if their underlying rationale and preferred policy fixes diverge once the specifics are debated.
segments.tr: O resultado, em estados como Wisconsin, Ohio e Flórida, é um ambiente político onde aspirantes a governador de ambos os partidos encontraram espaço para fazer campanha com promessas que soam similares — licenciamento mais rígido, acordos obrigatórios de benefício comunitário ou moratórios completos sobre novas aprovações pendentes de estudos adicionais — mesmo que sua lógica subjacente e correções de política preferidas divirjam uma vez que os detalhes são debatidos.

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument
segments.tr: ## O Contra-argumento da Indústria

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: Empresas de tecnologia e grupos de concessionárias contra-argumentaram, alegando que data centers trazem receita fiscal significativa, empregos de construção e investimento de longo prazo para as comunidades anfitriãs, e que frequentemente são obrigadas a financiar as próprias atualizações de rede que os críticos dizem onerar os consumidores.

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: Representantes da indústria também observam que muitas novas instalações estão contratando diretamente energia renovável ou pagando prêmios especificamente para evitar deslocar custos para clientes residenciais.

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: Funcionários de desenvolvimento econômico estadual em várias dessas corridas alertaram que um moratório abrangente arrisca empurrar investimentos — e os empregos e a base tributária que vêm com isso — para estados ou países mais permissivos, sem necessariamente resolver as questões subjacentes de capacidade de rede que antecedem o boom de IA.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## O Que Observar Antes de Novembro

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:
segments.tr: Para eleitores tentando distinguir retórica de política, algumas questões valem a pena rastrear conforme essas corridas se desenvolvem:

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **Quem paga pelas atualizações de rede?** Observe propostas específicas sobre alocação de custos entre grandes clientes industriais e consumidores residenciais, pois este é o mecanismo mais diretamente vinculado aos aumentos de contas.

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **O que conta como uma "pausa"?** Propostas de moratório variam amplamente — algumas visam apenas novas aprovações de permissão, outras interromperiam projetos já em construção, o que levanta questões legais e contratuais separadas.

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **Como o uso de água é medido e divulgado?** Instalações usando sistemas de resfriamento por ar versus resfriamento por água têm impactos locais muito diferentes, e os requisitos de transparência em nível estadual diferem significativamente.

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.
segments.tr: Como ocorre com a maioria das batalhas de infraestrutura que chegam à urna, os detalhes da implementação provavelmente importarão mais do que os slogans de campanha.

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.
segments.tr: Se "a pauta do moratório" se torna uma agenda de governo durável ou um pico retórico do ciclo de 2026 dependerá em grande parte de como esses candidatos traduzem uma reclamação popular em regulamentação viável uma vez que estejam no cargo.

segments.tr: このサイクルが注目に値する理由は、懐疑論が政党の線に沿ってきれいに分類されないことです。

segments.src: In traditionally conservative areas, opposition has often centered on local control, property rights, and protecting agricultural land and rural water tables from industrial-scale development.
segments.tr: 伝統的に保守的な地域では、反対は地方自治、財産権、農地と農村の地下水を工業規模の開発から保護することを中心に展開されています。

segments.src: In more liberal areas, the emphasis tends to fall on environmental review, corporate accountability for infrastructure costs, and equitable rate-setting.
segments.tr: より自由主義的な地域では、環境影響評価、インフラコストに対する企業責任、公平な料金設定に重点が置かれる傾向があります。

segments.src: The result, in states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Florida, is a political environment where gubernatorial hopefuls from both parties have found room to campaign on similar-sounding promises — tighter permitting, mandatory community benefit agreements, or outright moratoriums on new approvals pending further study — even if their underlying rationale and preferred policy fixes diverge once the specifics are debated.
segments.tr: ウィスコンシン州、オハイオ州、フロリダ州などの州での結果は、両党の知事候補者が似たような約束でキャンペーンを行うための余地を見つけた政治環境です。つまり、より厳格な許可手続き、強制的なコミュニティ便益協定、またはさらなる研究保留中の新規承認の完全な一時停止ですが、具体性が議論されると根底にある根拠と好ましい政策修正が異なる場合があります。

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument
segments.tr: ## 業界の反論

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: 技術企業と公益事業グループは反論し、データセンターがホストコミュニティに大きな税収、建設雇用、長期投資をもたらし、批評家が利用者に負担をかけると言っているまさにそのグリッドアップグレードの資金提供が頻繁に必要とされていると主張しています。

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: 業界の代表者はまた、多くの新しい施設が再生可能エネルギー用に直接契約しているか、住宅顧客にコストをシフトさせないようにするために特にプレミアムを支払っていることに言及しています。

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: これらのレースのいくつかの州の経済開発当局者は、包括的な一時停止がAIブームより前の根底にあるグリッド容量の問題を必ずしも解決することなく、投資（およびそれに伴う雇用と税ベース）をより緩い州または国に押し込むリスクがあると警告しています。

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## 11月前に注視すべきこと

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **グリッドアップグレードに誰が費用を支払うか？** 大規模産業顧客と住宅利用者の間のコスト配分に関する具体的な提案に注視してください。これは請求書の増加に最も直接的に結びついているメカニズムです。

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **「一時停止」とは何をいうのか？** 一時停止の提案は広く異なります。新しい許可承認のみをターゲットにするものもあれば、既に建設中のプロジェクトを停止するものもあり、これは別の法的および契約上の問題を提起します。

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **水の使用はどのように測定および開示されるか？** 空冷システムと水冷システムを使用する施設は非常に異なるローカルインパクトを持ち、州レベルの透明性要件は大きく異なります。

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.

segments.src: ## A New Kind of Campaign Issue
segments.tr: ## Ein neues Wahlkampfthema

segments.src: Data centers used to be the kind of infrastructure story that stayed in trade publications and local zoning meetings.
segments.tr: Rechenzentren waren früher die Art von Infrastrukturgeschichte, die in Fachpublikationen und lokalen Stadtplanungssitzungen blieb.

segments.src: Heading into the 2026 midterms, that has changed.
segments.tr: Vor den Midterm-Wahlen 2026 hat sich das geändert.

segments.src: In statehouse races from the upper Midwest to the Gulf Coast, candidates are discovering that a pledge to pause, slow, or tightly regulate new data center construction can be as galvanizing on the campaign trail as taxes or crime once were.
segments.tr: Bei Wahlen zum Repräsentantenhaus vom Upper Midwest bis zur Golfküste stellen Kandidaten fest, dass ein Versprechen, neue Rechenzentrumsbauten zu unterbrechen, zu verlangsamen oder streng zu regulieren, auf dem Wahlkampfpfad genauso mobilisierend wirken kann wie Steuern oder Kriminalität einst.

segments.src: The shift reflects a simple reality: the artificial intelligence boom has a physical footprint, and voters are starting to feel it in ways that show up on monthly bills rather than in abstract debates about technology policy.
segments.tr: Der Wechsel spiegelt eine einfache Realität wider: Der KI-Boom hat einen physischen Fußabdruck, und Wähler spüren ihn in Wegen, die sich in monatlichen Rechnungen zeigen, anstatt in abstrakten Debatten über Technologiepolitik.

segments.src: ## Power Bills Are the Trigger
segments.tr: ## Stromrechnungen sind der Auslöser

segments.src: The core grievance driving this trend is economic, not ideological.
segments.tr: Die Kernbeschwerde, die diesen Trend antreibt, ist wirtschaftlich, nicht ideologisch.

segments.src: Data centers, particularly the large campuses built to train and run AI models, consume enormous amounts of electricity — often as much as a mid-sized city.
segments.tr: Rechenzentren, insbesondere die großen Campus, die zum Trainieren und Ausführen von KI-Modellen gebaut wurden, verbrauchen enorme Strommengen – oft so viel wie eine mittelgroße Stadt.

segments.src: In several states, utilities have proposed or won approval for new transmission lines, gas plants, and rate structures tied directly to serving these facilities.
segments.tr: In mehreren Bundesstaaten haben Versorgungsunternehmen neue Übertragungsleitungen, Gaskraftwerke und Tarifstrukturen, die direkt mit der Versorgung dieser Anlagen verbunden sind, vorgeschlagen oder genehmigt erhalten.

segments.src: Ratepayer advocates and some state regulators have raised concerns that the cost of that new capacity is, in part, being spread across residential customers rather than falling solely on the companies building the data centers.
segments.tr: Vertreter der Stromkunden und einige staatliche Regulatoren haben Bedenken geäußert, dass die Kosten dieser neuen Kapazität teilweise auf Wohnkunden verteilt werden, anstatt ausschließlich auf die Unternehmen zu fallen, die die Rechenzentren bauen.

segments.src: That dynamic has given candidates a tangible, kitchen-table argument: household electricity bills rising while nearby land is cleared for server farms that employ relatively few permanent workers once construction ends.
segments.tr: Diese Dynamik hat Kandidaten ein greifbares, Küchentisch-Argument gegeben: steigende Stromrechnungen im Haushalt, während sich nebenan das Land für Serverfarmen räumt, die nach Bauende relativ wenige Dauerarbeitsplätze schaffen.

segments.src: Water use has become a parallel flashpoint, particularly in warmer or drought-prone regions, where cooling systems for large facilities draw on municipal or groundwater supplies that communities also rely on for drinking water and agriculture.
segments.tr: Der Wasserverbrauch ist zu einem parallelen Streitpunkt geworden, insbesondere in wärmeren oder trockenheitsanfälligen Regionen, wo Kühlsysteme für große Anlagen Gemeinde- oder Grundwasservorräte anzapfen, auf die Gemeinden auch für Trinkwasser und Landwirtschaft angewiesen sind.

segments.src: ## A Rare Point of Bipartisan Overlap
segments.tr: ## Ein seltener Punkt überparteilicher Überschneidung

segments.src: What makes this cycle notable is that the skepticism doesn't sort neatly along party lines.
segments.tr: Was diesen Zyklus bemerkenswert macht, ist, dass die Skepsis sich nicht ordentlich nach Parteilinien sortiert.

segments.src: In traditionally conservative areas, opposition has often centered on local control, property rights, and protecting agricultural land and rural water tables from industrial-scale development.
segments.tr: In traditionell konservativen Gebieten hat sich die Opposition oft auf lokale Kontrolle, Eigentumsrechte und den Schutz von Agrarland und ländlichen Grundwasserspiegeln vor großindustrieller Entwicklung konzentriert.

segments.src: In more liberal areas, the emphasis tends to fall on environmental review, corporate accountability for infrastructure costs, and equitable rate-setting.
segments.tr: In liberaleren Gebieten liegt der Schwerpunkt auf Umweltprüfung, Unternehmensverantwortung für Infrastrukturkosten und gerechter Tarifgestaltung.

segments.src: The result, in states like Wisconsin, Ohio, and Florida, is a political environment where gubernatorial hopefuls from both parties have found room to campaign on similar-sounding promises — tighter permitting, mandatory community benefit agreements, or outright moratoriums on new approvals pending further study — even if their underlying rationale and preferred policy fixes diverge once the specifics are debated.
segments.tr: Das Ergebnis ist in Staaten wie Wisconsin, Ohio und Florida ein politisches Umfeld, in dem Kandidaten für das Gouverneursamt aus beiden Parteien Platz gefunden haben, um mit ähnlich klingenden Versprechen Wahlkampf zu betreiben – strengere Genehmigungsverfahren, obligatorische Vereinbarungen über Leistungen für die Gemeinde oder ausdrückliche Moratorien für neue Genehmigungen bis zur weiteren Untersuchung – auch wenn ihre zugrunde liegende Begründung und bevorzugten Richtlinienmaßnahmen auseinander gehen, sobald die Besonderheiten debattiert werden.

segments.src: ## The Industry's Counterargument
segments.tr: ## Die Gegenargumente der Industrie

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: Technologieunternehmen und Versorgungsgruppen haben widersprochen und argumentieren, dass Rechenzentren erhebliche Steuereinnahmen, Bauarbeitsplätze und langfristige Investitionen in Gastgemeinden bringen, und dass sie häufig verpflichtet sind, genau die Netzaufrüstungen zu finanzieren, die Kritiker sagen, belasten Stromkunden.

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: Branchenvertreter merken auch an, dass viele neue Anlagen direkt Verträge für erneuerbare Energien abschließen oder Prämien zahlen, um speziell zu vermeiden, Kosten auf Wohnkunden zu verlagern.

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: Beamte der staatlichen Wirtschaftsentwicklung in mehreren dieser Rennen haben gewarnt, dass ein pauschales Moratorium das Risiko birgt, Investitionen – und die damit verbundenen Arbeitsplätze und Steuerbasis – in permissivere Staaten oder Länder zu verschieben, ohne notwendigerweise die zugrunde liegenden Netzkapazitätsfragen zu lösen, die dem KI-Boom vorausgehen.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## Was man vor November beobachten sollte

segments.tr: Für Wähler, die versuchen, Rhetorik von Politik zu unterscheiden, sind einige Fragen es wert, verfolgt zu werden, während sich diese Rennen entwickeln:

segments.tr: - **Was zählt als eine "Pause"?** Moratoriumsvorschläge variieren stark – einige zielen nur auf neue Genehmigungen ab, andere würden Projekte, die bereits im Bau sind, stoppen, was separate rechtliche und vertragliche Fragen aufwirft.

segments.tr: Wie bei den meisten Infrastrukturkämpfen, die den Wahlzettel erreichen, werden die Implementierungsdetails wahrscheinlich mehr zählen als die Wahlkampfslogans.

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.

segments.tr: ## Lập Luận Phản Đối Của Ngành

segments.src: Technology companies and utility groups have pushed back, arguing that data centers bring significant tax revenue, construction jobs, and long-term investment to host communities, and that they are frequently required to fund the very grid upgrades critics say burden ratepayers.
segments.tr: Các công ty công nghệ và nhóm tiện ích đã phản đối, lập luận rằng các trung tâm dữ liệu mang lại doanh thu thuế đáng kể, việc làm xây dựng, và đầu tư dài hạn cho các cộng đồng chủ nhà, và rằng họ thường được yêu cầu để tài trợ cho chính những nâng cấp lưới điện mà những người chỉ trích nói gây gánh nặng cho cử tri điện.

segments.src: Industry representatives also note that many new facilities are contracting directly for renewable power or paying premiums specifically to avoid shifting costs onto residential customers.
segments.tr: Các đại diện ngành cũng lưu ý rằng nhiều cơ sở mới đang ký hợp đồng trực tiếp cho năng lượng tái tạo hoặc trả phí cao hơn cụ thể để tránh chuyển chi phí cho khách hàng dân cư.

segments.src: State economic development officials in several of these races have warned that a blanket moratorium risks pushing investment — and the jobs and tax base that come with it — to more permissive states or countries, without necessarily solving the underlying grid capacity questions that predate the AI boom.
segments.tr: Các nhà chức trách phát triển kinh tế tiểu bang ở một số cuộc đua này đã cảnh báo rằng một lệnh trì hoãn toàn diện có nguy cơ đẩy đầu tư — và những việc làm và cơ sở thuế đi kèm với nó — đến các tiểu bang hoặc quốc gia cho phép hơn, mà không nhất thiết phải giải quyết các câu hỏi về công suất lưới điện cơ bản trước cuộc bùng nổ AI.

segments.src: ## What to Watch Before November
segments.tr: ## Điều Cần Xem Trước Tháng 11

segments.src: For voters trying to sort rhetoric from policy, a few questions are worth tracking as these races develop:
segments.tr: Đối với các cử tri cố gắng sắp xếp lý thuyết từ chính sách, một vài câu hỏi đáng để theo dõi khi những cuộc đua này phát triển:

segments.src: - **Who pays for grid upgrades?** Watch for specific proposals on cost allocation between large industrial customers and residential ratepayers, since this is the mechanism most directly tied to bill increases.
segments.tr: - **Ai trả tiền cho nâng cấp lưới điện?** Theo dõi các đề xuất cụ thể về phân bổ chi phí giữa khách hàng công nghiệp lớn và cử tri điện dân cư, vì đây là cơ chế liên quan trực tiếp nhất đến tăng hóa đơn.

segments.src: - **What counts as a "pause"?** Moratorium proposals vary widely — some target new permit approvals only, others would halt projects already under construction, which raises separate legal and contractual questions.
segments.tr: - **Điều gì được tính là "tạm dừng"?** Các đề xuất trì hoãn khác nhau rộng rãi — một số chỉ nhắm mục tiêu phê duyệt giấy phép mới, những người khác sẽ dừng các dự án đã trong quá trình xây dựng, điều này đặt ra những câu hỏi pháp lý và hợp đồng riêng biệt.

segments.src: - **How is water use measured and disclosed?** Facilities using air-cooling versus water-cooling systems have very different local impacts, and state-level transparency requirements differ significantly.
segments.tr: - **Sử dụng nước được đo lường và công bố như thế nào?** Các cơ sở sử dụng hệ thống làm mát bằng không khí so với làm mát bằng nước có tác động địa phương rất khác nhau, và các yêu cầu minh bạch ở cấp tiểu bang khác nhau đáng kể.

segments.src: As with most infrastructure fights that reach the ballot box, the details of implementation are likely to matter more than the campaign slogans.
segments.tr: Như với hầu hết các trận chiến cơ sở hạ tầng đạt đến hộp phiếu, các chi tiết triển khai có khả năng quan trọng hơn các khẩu hiệu chiến dịch.

segments.src: Whether "the moratorium ticket" becomes a durable governing agenda or a rhetorical high point of the 2026 cycle will depend largely on how these candidates translate a popular grievance into workable regulation once they're in office.
segments.tr: Liệu "vé trì hoãn" có trở thành một chương trình điều hành bền vững hay một điểm cao của lý thuyết trong chu kỳ năm 2026 sẽ phụ thuộc phần lớn vào cách những ứng cử viên này chuyển một phàn nàn phổ biến thành quy định khả thi khi họ nhận chức.
